credit_policy: Each failed witness remains a retained operational negative with zero validation or completion credit. A bounded recovery never erases the failure.

records.failed_witness: A pipeline-scoped $_ value was read outside its pipeline and produced a null LiteralPath.
records.recovery: Use the known literal scalar path directly.
records.passing_witness: The scalar path read returned the intended file.
records.recurrence_guard: Never rely on $_ outside the active pipeline block.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use literal-path scalar probes for known files.

records.failed_witness: Unquoted HEAD...@{u} was parsed by PowerShell and mangled instead of reaching Git literally.
records.recovery: Quote the complete revision expression as a scalar Git argument.
records.passing_witness: Git returned zero ahead and zero behind.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat Git revision expressions as literal arguments.

records.failed_witness: An overescaped word-count regular expression returned zero for the activation baton.
records.recovery: Use decoded-text split semantics once and compare with hash, lines, and bytes.
records.recurrence_guard: Test regex quoting on a tiny fixture before a long-file count.
records.rollback: The zero count received no credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer a small explicit word-count function over shell-escaping layers.

records.failed_witness: Large activation-baton display windows were truncated at six locations.
records.recovery: Reread each missing interval with literal bounded line ranges.
records.passing_witness: All six gaps and the final EOF region were directly read.
records.recurrence_guard: Use smaller numbered windows for long files.
records.rollback: Do not claim EOF until every truncated interval is recovered.
records.sibling_recommendation: Record missing line ranges immediately when a display truncates.

records.failed_witness: A combined authorization-state display exceeded the output budget.
records.recovery: Read the complete state in bounded numbered chunks and validate it separately.
records.passing_witness: The full 1477-line state and schema validator were read successfully.
records.recurrence_guard: Separate large state files from other tool output.
records.rollback: The truncated display supplied no completeness credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Validate structure after bounded full reads.

records.failed_witness: A guidance reader assumed PowerShell $args would be populated although no argument array was supplied.
records.recovery: Embed each trusted literal path as a single-quoted scalar.
records.passing_witness: All named guidance files were then read completely.
records.recurrence_guard: Use explicit tool argument fields or literal scalars, never implicit $args.
records.sibling_recommendation: Test a reader wrapper on one file before batching.

records.failed_witness: A combined guidance read exceeded the output budget and truncated orchestration content.
records.recovery: Reread the orchestration, closeout, and full-tools skills independently through their exact line counts.
records.passing_witness: Every selected SKILL.md and required reference was read through EOF.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep each long skill in its own output envelope.
records.rollback: The partial batch received no full-read credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use one file per read when a skill exceeds roughly two hundred lines.

records.failed_witness: python -m pytest could not collect the inherited test because pytest is not installed.
records.recovery: Use the module's declared unittest entrypoint and avoid unrelated installation.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect the test framework before selecting a runner.
records.rollback: Do not install unrelated software merely to satisfy a guessed runner.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer stdlib unittest when the file imports unittest and provides __main__.

records.failed_witness: The assumed auth validator filename did not exist.
records.recovery: List only the exact auth skill scripts directory and select validate_auth_permission_state.py.
records.passing_witness: The actual validator returned valid true.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect exact script names before invocation.
records.rollback: The missing-file invocation earned zero credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use a narrow directory listing rather than guessing family-current script names.
